slides.narration: Chapter 25: The Graph-to-Field Bridge. This chapter answers the deepest structural question: how does a discrete tower of golden-ratio positions produce the continuous fields and forces of the Standard Model?

The answer is the same way atoms produce smooth water. The discrete lattice, in its continuum limit, produces exactly the Standard Model Lagrangian — the master equation of particle physics. The Jordan-Wigner theorem maps the lattice positions to fermionic quantum fields, and the three bridge modes become the three colors of the strong force.
